one_month_reasoning: No earnings in the window (Q4 FY2026 results and the first FY2027 guide come around 2027-01-20, after 2026-12-17). In-window events: the first Thanksgiving Eve NFL game (2026-11-25) and the build-up to the Christmas Day NFL games, holiday slate, and any 15-country ad-tier detail; none is likely to move estimates. The stock is at a 52-week low after a -46% year and a post-print slide (65.12 on 10-21 to 59.68), so momentum is negative but short-term reversal after sharp falls offsets it. I stay near a symmetric lognormal around 59.68 at ~10.3% monthly vol (36%/3.5) with slightly fatter tails and a tiny positive drift.

Alternatives: hold 2025's 7.75% (paid-sharing tail still running) or 4% flat (engagement +2% H1'26 says time spent is near saturation).

inputs_detail.derivation: Actual quarters = (1 + reported revenue growth) / (1 + mem_g) - 1. Q4'26 4.8% (Q3'26 residual 5.0%, FX-neutral growth a point below reported). 2027-28 4.5%: periodic price rises (~3% a year contribution, as in 2025-26 per the letters) plus ads ($2.7B growing ~50% adds ~2.5 pts of revenue) less mix toward lower-ARM APAC/India (~1 pt). Alternatives: 6% (ads double again as in 2025-26) or 3% (price rises paused after the 2026 round).

Q4'26 8.8% = guide-consistent: Q4 revenue 13.44B less operating income 3.50B less opex ~2.80B leaves ~7.10B cost of revenues vs 6.52B. 2027 8.5% and 2028 8.0%: amortization growth a little below 2026's ~10% guide as the slate is built out, plus live sports (NFL final-week games 2027, MLB) at ~5% of content spend. Alternatives: 10% (2026 pace held) or 7% (2024-25 ex-Brazil pace).

Q4'26 8.9% from the Q4 guide arithmetic (2.80B vs 2.57B). 2027: Q1 0% laps Q1'26 G&A of 602.6M (WBD deal costs), Q2 +4%, Q3 +5%, Q4 +2% laps ~160M Q4'26 severance; ~1,000 job cuts lower the run rate; FY +2.7%. 2028 +7.5% (ad tech and technology build). Peer median of DIS 16.64x, SONY 17.66x, META 18.56x, GOOGL 19.29x, SPOT 38.86x = 18.56x (2026-11-18 refresh rows). Own NTM P/E on the same basis 59.68 / 3.655 = 16.33x. Exit = 18.56 x (16.33/18.56)^0.8 = 16.75x.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Peer median exactly (18.56x) would add ~11%; DIS-only (16.6x) about -1%.

reasoning: Primary documents first: the four 2026 letters, the Q3 10-Q and the Q3 call. Q3 FY2026: revenue 12.87B (+12%), margin 34.6%, FY2026 guide 51.1B / 31.5%, ad revenue cut to ~2.7B, ~1,000 job cuts, record $4.8B buyback; H1 view hours +2% (Q2 letter). The stock fell 46% in a year (WBD bid and walk-away, then growth/engagement worries and the ad cut); it trades at 16.3x Street NTM EPS. Build: revenue = members x ARM by quarter (members 301.6M end-2024 -> 325M end-2025; 2026-28 growth slowing to ~4.5%), ARM +4.5% from price rounds and ads less mix; cost of revenues +8.5%/+8% (content amortization +9.5% YTD), opex nearly flat in 2027 after the cuts. Result: margin 31.6%/33.7%/34.4%, GAAP EPS FY2027 3.90 (Zacks 3.74, +4%), FY2028 4.53 (4.43, +2%). Guidance record: margin guides beaten 3 of 3 years (median +8.5%), quarterly revenue guides within 1%; we sit inside the FY guides because the 9M actuals fix them. Multiple: 5 peers, median 18.56x, shrunk k=0.8 to 16.75x. Downside (P10) cuts member and ARM growth by 2.5 and 2 pts and the multiple by 4 turns; upside (P90) adds 1.5/1.5 pts, lower opex and 3.5 turns. Moderately conservative per project rules; research done mostly by WebFetch of filings.

model_inputs.structure_note: One segment (streaming). Quarterly driver build: revenue = last year's quarter x (1 + paid-membership growth) x (1 + ARM growth); EBIT = revenue - cost of revenues (content amortization ~71%) - marketing/technology/G&A, each grown y/y from its own evidence. Value is carried by one P/E (NTM at the horizon) leg on the build's own GAAP EPS (SBC costed), 16.75x from the peer median shrunk with k = 0.8. No SOTP: ads are ~5% of revenue and not reported separately. Driven share of revenue 100%.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian (engine-sized vs base 72.59): mem_g held at 2025's 7.75% = +15.2%; mem_g 4% flat = -5.2%; arm_g 6% = +8.2%; arm_g 3% = -8.1% (each >5%, card). cor_g 10%/7% = -4.4%/+3.2%; opex 2027 +6%/0% = -1.8%/+1.4%. Member counts are estimates (no quarterly disclosure since Q1 2025); actual-quarter mem_g values are flagged. No shares.buyback block: buybacks retire ~4% a year, so a reprice would move the target ~1% for a 25% price move; supervisor may add one. No financing event >=20% probability (no announced deal after the WBD bid lapsed; a large M&A bid is in thesis triggers). Peer set is 5 names (comps_summary.peer_count_flag). fair_value.value = engine base horizon value.
